sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2023
sources.text: Duty oiler onboard an anchored tanker noticed three robbers armed with steel bars near the engine room. The robbers saw the duty oiler and threatened to attack him, but the oiler managed to run away. Alarm raised and PA announcement made, resulting in the robbers escaping without stealing anything. All crew mustered and a search was carried out. Incident reported to the authorities through the local agent.
